capabilities: Convert Markdown to WeChat-formatted output with custom CSS, SVG math and rasterized Mermaid
Sync articles to WeChat Official Account draft boxes via the official API
Publish notes to Feishu cloud docs with in-place updates
Export multi-page social image cards (6 themes, 3:4/3:5/9:16) as PNG
Distribute drafts to Zhihu, Juejin, CSDN and more via a companion browser extension
disambiguation: Not only a Markdown converter; it also publishes drafts directly to WeChat, Feishu and other platforms and exports multi-page image cards.
extras: Free and open source (MIT); the author solicits donations via QR codes. The repo ships no build artifacts, so manual installs need GitHub Releases. A PROXY_GUIDE.md covers a Cloudflare Worker proxy for WeChat IP-whitelist issues. The README claims fully local operation with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format notes for WeChat's editor or push them to platform draft boxes, so writers resort to external formatting tools and manual copying that breaks formulas, Mermaid diagrams and code blocks.
